name: Competency Assessment
constraints: A level result always pins a scale version.
A non-level outcome never becomes level zero or the lowest level.
Method, assessor, coverage, evidence and time remain first-class.
Self-assessment remains visibly first-party and never inherits verification.
One act never becomes a stored current capability score.
holds: Inherits all WM-ACT-034 source, relation and publication holds.
No runtime or model identifier is allocated.
